name: Color Memory
tagline: Five colors. Seconds to look. Rebuild them from memory.
howTo: When it vanishes, rebuild it with hue, saturation and brightness.
Scored with CIEDE2000 ΔE: the closer, the better.

name: Pitch Memory
tagline: Hear a tone. Dial it back in.
howTo: Turn the dial to recreate the frequency (preview as much as you like).
Scored in cents: 5¢ is near-perfect, a semitone is 100¢.

name: Shade Match
tagline: Pure grayscale. Remember the exact brightness.
howTo: Recreate its lightness with one slider.

name: Gradient Recall
tagline: Two color stops. Rebuild the blend.
howTo: Set the hue and brightness of both ends.
Each stop is scored with ΔE.

name: Rhythm Echo
tagline: Hear a beat. Tap it back, millisecond perfect.
howTo: Tap it back with the pad, Space or any key.
Scored by timing error on every interval.

name: Tempo Memory
tagline: Feel the BPM. Recreate the pulse.
howTo: A metronome plays for a few beats.
Set the BPM with the dial or tap it in.

name: Volume Memory
tagline: Remember how loud it was.
howTo: A tone plays at a hidden loudness.
Slide the fader to match it.

name: Chord Ear
tagline: Hear a chord. Rebuild it note by note.
howTo: Toggle piano keys to rebuild it. Replay both any time.

name: Shape Memory
tagline: Memorize a shape. Drag the points to rebuild it.
howTo: Drag the handles to recreate its outline.

name: Size Memory
tagline: How big was that circle?
howTo: Resize your circle to match its radius.

name: Angle Memory
tagline: Two rays. One angle. Remember it.
howTo: Drag the arm to recreate it.

name: Position Memory
tagline: Where was the dot?
howTo: A dot appears for a moment.

name: Length Memory
tagline: Remember the length of a line.
howTo: A line flashes (and may rotate in recall).

name: Grid Flash
tagline: Cells light up. Tap them back.
howTo: Some cells flash on a grid.
Each level adds cells. Three strikes and you're out.

name: Echo Pads
tagline: Watch, listen, repeat. The sequence keeps growing.
howTo: Four pads light up with tones.
It grows by one each round.

name: Number Flash
tagline: Digits flash. Type them back.
howTo: Each round adds a digit. Two strikes and you're out.

name: Face Paint
tagline: Remember a portrait's palette.
howTo: Study a portrait's skin, hair, eyes and shirt.
Every part is scored with ΔE.

name: Speed Memory
tagline: How fast did it move?
howTo: Set the speed and preview it.

name: Duration Memory
tagline: Feel the seconds. Hold for exactly that long.
howTo: A pulse lasts a hidden duration.
Press and hold for the same time.

name: Emoji Order
tagline: Remember the order. Rebuild the line.
howTo: Tap them back in the same order.

name: Fivefold
tagline: Guess the five-letter word in six tries.
howTo: Green: right spot. Yellow: wrong spot. Gray: not in the word.

name: Hex Hunt
tagline: Guess the hidden HEX color.
howTo: Arrows show if each digit should go up or down.

name: Flag Fragment
tagline: Just a slice of a flag. Which country?
howTo: A zoomed-in fragment of a flag appears.
Pick the country. Wrong guesses zoom out.

name: Number Target
tagline: Six numbers. One target. Do the math.
howTo: Each number can be used once.

name: Quad Groups
tagline: Sixteen words. Four hidden groups.
howTo: Pick four words that share a link.

name: Heavier?
tagline: Which weighs more? Keep the streak alive.

name: Anagram
tagline: Unscramble the day's words.
howTo: Type the answer. Hints cost points.

name: Emoji Riddle
tagline: Read the emoji. Name the thing.
howTo: Each riddle is a word or phrase in emoji.
Type your answer. Letter hints cost points.

name: Mini Cross
tagline: A bite-size crossword, new every day.
howTo: Solve fast for a higher score.

name: Sudoku
tagline: A gentle daily sudoku.
howTo: Fill every row, column and box with 1-9.
Mistakes are flagged and cost points.

name: Country Shape
tagline: Name the country from its outline.

name: Color of Things
tagline: What color is a ripe lemon, really?
howTo: You get the name of an everyday thing.
Scored with ΔE against a reference.

name: Odd One Out
tagline: One tile is different. Find it fast.
howTo: Tap the tile that's slightly off.

name: Pixel Reveal
tagline: Blocky to sharp. Guess early for big points.

name: Daily Maze
tagline: One maze for the whole world today.
howTo: Fewer moves and less time, higher score.

name: Card Flip
tagline: Match every pair against the clock.
howTo: Flip two cards at a time.
Fewer moves and less time, higher score.

name: Reaction
tagline: Wait for green. Then strike.
howTo: Wait for the screen to turn green.
Tap as fast as you can.
Five tries. Average counts. Too early costs you.

name: Type Rush
tagline: Today's text. Your fastest fingers.

name: Aim Trainer
tagline: Thirty targets. Click them all.
howTo: Click each target as it appears.

name: Mole Sprint
tagline: Thirty seconds. Bop every critter.

name: Hue Sort
tagline: Put the shuffled gradient back in order.
howTo: Tap two tiles to swap them.

name: Stroop Rush
tagline: Read the ink, not the word.
howTo: A color word appears in a colored ink.
Tap the INK color, not the word.
